Actually the schema components have characteristics{} but the structured values rule says every characteristic value MUST be an object with value/unit_symbol/unit_id/footnote_markers. Footnotes: "*" Emax, nmax and Y are specified for the digital load cell listed in the certificate of the weighing module. So footnotes: [{"marker": "*", "text": "Emax, nmax and Y are specified for the digital load cell listed in the certificate of the weighing module."}]

This is a config-level matrix: attribute rated_minimum_fill, axis "operational accuracy class", conditions per d value? It's two-dimensional: d × accuracy class. Hmm.
